revisions: First audit run: 31/34. Two failures came from the audit itself: the sign-flip and McNemar p-values were compared at 1e-9 with values that summary.json stores rounded to 6 decimals (exact 8/16384 = 0.00048828 stored 0.000488; McNemar 8.7976e-05 stored 8.8e-05). The tolerance is now 5e-7, half the last stored digit.

The third failure was real: run_context.json contained the first 40 characters of question mmlb-0033 (a label in the single-pass check). The notebook now labels queries by id; run_context.json was regenerated and re-frozen. No result file changed.
scope_note: Software and arithmetic checks. They do not show that the annotations are correct, that the 14 documents represent other documents, or that more supplied evidence yields more correct answers.
